title: A deckbuilding roguelite where you craft your cards from resources instead of looting them. Thoughts?
author: Arkenge

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: 1000 possible cards sounds fun, but only if players can predict what adding a resource will do. could the crafting screen preview the effect before spending it? otherwise i might keep using the same safe recipe every run.

replies.author: Arkenge
replies.body: Yes that’s exactly how it works :) otherwise it wouldn’t be fun. Plus, each new card crafted will give you a “knowledge” point that it use for meta progression. The purpose is to encourage player to try different build and get rewarded by doing so :)
